career_ladder.note: Reserve Bank of India Grade B Officers (Direct Recruits) form the central leadership pipeline of India's monetary authority. Officers handle monetary policy transmission, banking supervision, financial stability, payment systems, and foreign exchange reserves management. Promotions through senior management and executive grades are governed by merit appraisal and interview boards.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted in three successive phases: Phase-I Online Examination (Objective screening), Phase-II Online Examination (Descriptive & Objective papers on Economic & Social Issues, English Writing Skills, and Finance & Management), followed by Phase-III Interview. Negative marking of 1/4th of marks assigned to the question applies in objective tests.

papers.paper_name: Paper-I: Economic and Social Issues (50% Objective + 50% Descriptive)
Paper-II: English (Writing Skills — Essay, Précis, Comprehension / Business Drafting)
Paper-III: Finance and Management (50% Objective + 50% Descriptive)

stages.source_label: RBI Services Board — Interview Guidelines & Final Aggregate Weightage

papers.paper_name: Board Interview (Aggregate merit: Phase-II 300 marks + Interview 75 marks = 375 marks)

financial_package.estimate_note: Officers in Grade B draw starting basic pay of ₹55,200/month. Total initial monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹1,16,684 (without bank accommodation) or ₹95,000+ (with accommodation). Allowances include Dearness Allowance, Local Compensatory Allowance, Special Allowance, Grade Allowance, and Family Allowance. Actual in-hand varies by city posting tier and NPS/tax deductions.
official_perks: Bank residential quarters in prime metropolitan locations or House Rent Allowance (15% of basic)
Reimbursement of expenses for maintenance of vehicle for official purpose / petrol allowance
Newspaper, book grant, telephone charges, and brief case allowances
Dispensary facilities and comprehensive hospitalization insurance coverage for officer and family
Leave Fare Concession (LFC) once in two years for self and eligible dependents
Interest-free or concessional rate loans for housing, car, and education

competition_benchmarks.note: RBI Grade B is widely regarded as the most competitive central banking recruitment in Asia, attracting top-tier engineering, economics, and finance graduates across India.
